analysis.note: Adopted reading: early Vulgate manuscript (Amiatinus); other reading(s): Clementine Vulgate.

Policy decision: one early Vulgate manuscript (Amiatinus) against the Clementine edition, with no third Hieronymian witness. Amiatinus, the oldest complete Vulgate, is followed; check against a critical Vulgate.
